question: Discuss the factors that a company should consider while planning its capital structure.
sources: Capital structure planning: factors determining the debt-equity mix

points.label: Risk
points.description: More debt means fixed interest and repayment, which raises financial risk; a firm with unstable earnings should use less debt.

points.label: Cost of capital and trading on equity
points.description: Debt is usually cheaper and interest is tax-deductible, so using it can raise earnings per share if returns exceed the cost of debt.
points.basis: Capital structure planning: cost and EBIT-EPS analysis

points.label: Control
points.description: Issuing new equity may dilute the control of existing shareholders; debt does not carry voting rights.

points.label: Flexibility
points.description: The structure should allow the firm to raise more funds or reduce funds when needed.

points.label: Other factors
points.description: Nature and stability of the business, cash flow ability to service debt, market conditions, and legal or lender restrictions.
